messages:
deploy-bot: Starting change window: service=embed-svc version=embed-v2.1.0 rollout=r-2026-06-02-embedv2. Strategy: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 20m. Run /deploy-check and keep an eye on slo.p95 and route-errors.

sana: running /deploy-check now and warming caches. grabbing baseline metrics.

alex: warming done, shifting 5% to canary. watching latency dashboards.

/deploy-check output (sana):
```
baseline: p50=28ms p95=95ms p99=260ms
error_rate(all)=0.12%
edge-kv-hit=90%
no obvious anomalies -> proceed to 5% shift
```

oncall-bot: :warning: ALERT slo.p95(route=/embed) exceeded threshold in ap-south by 1.8x. current p95=210ms threshold=120ms. AlertID AP-8819.

tess: seeing a spike localized to ap-south-2 region. 5xx coming from embed-decode-2 pod group. stack shows decoder batch spike + GC pauses.

infra: temporarily draining embed-decode-2 and scaling decoder pool +2 replicas. also applying temporary route override to exclude ap-south from canary.

alex: route override pushed:
```
route=/embed split: {"ap-south": "stable", "global": "canary:5,stable:95"}
```

sana: re-run /deploy-check after override:
```
ap-south p95=420ms (draining)
global p95=100ms
5xx ap-south=2.3% -> decreasing
recommendation: hold rollout at 5% until decoder-scaling confirmed and ap-south p95 < 150ms for 2 consecutive checks
```

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by infra (r-2026-06-02-embedv2). Traffic: canary 5% global excluding ap-south pinned to stable.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Pause recorded. Next automated check in 8m. Incident ID I-20260602-06. If not resolved within 45m flag for postmortem.

alex: adding short note to release notes: "Pause: region-specific p95 & 5xx spike in ap-south. Excluding region from canary and scaling decoder pool. Investigating GC behavior under new batching."

sana: opened PR to adjust decoder batch-threshold and GC tuning -> PR #3124. linking heap logs and GC traces to incident thread.

tess: quick triage summary: likely regression from new batching heuristics in v2.1.0; memory pressure + GC pause causing tail latency in small region.

infra: spun up +2 replicas, confirmed pods healthy. ap-south p95 now 130ms after scaling.

alex: once we have 2 consecutive checks under threshold we can resume. checklist from release doc: 1) infra confirm replicas healthy 2) p95 < 150ms for 2 checks 3) remove region exclusion and ramp 5%->20% in 5m steps.

sana: agreed. scheduling resume check in 6m.

oncall-bot: :hourglass: scheduled check in 6m.

infra: note for postmortem if we escalate: capture GC logs, batch-size histograms, heap size per task, and routing split timestamps.

alex: thanks team. I'll update the changelog with a brief note and mark action items for the perf squad.

sana: :thumbsup:
